architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

services.role_in_journey: Owns OverdraftReview (ENT-054). Triggers nightly review batch. Performs persistent debt screening against transaction ledger. Makes review decision (renew/modify/withdraw/suspend). Updates Account (ENT-004) overdraft terms. Publishes all JRN-016 events.

consumed_events.name: OverdraftAssessmentCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-016 PH-084 -> PH-085: SVC-001 receives credit assessment and behavioural analysis results from SVC-012. Proceeds to persistent debt screening.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-001 owns OverdraftReview (ENT-054) because the review is a retail banking product lifecycle event. SVC-012 provides the credit assessment as input, but the decision and terms update belong to the product owner.
design_decisions.rationale: Clean boundary: SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) provides risk assessment; SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001) makes the product decision and owns the customer relationship.

services.role_in_journey: Performs credit bureau refresh and behavioural analysis at PH-084. Produces credit grade and affordability score. Publishes OverdraftAssessmentCompleted (EVT-115). Does not make the review decision — only provides risk assessment input.

consumed_events.name: OverdraftReviewTriggered
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-016 PH-083 -> PH-084: SVC-012 receives review trigger from SVC-001. Initiates credit bureau refresh and behavioural analysis for the specified account.

field_mappings.note: Used to look up customer and initiate bureau refresh
Correlation ID for the assessment response

consumed_apis.purpose: Refreshes credit bureau data for the customer. Returns credit score, adverse data flags, and financial commitments.

design_decisions.decision: SVC-012 (CAP-004) provides the credit assessment via async event (EVT-115), not via a synchronous API call from SVC-001.
design_decisions.rationale: Cross-capability communication rule: CAP-001 -> CAP-004 must be async. SVC-001 publishes OverdraftReviewTriggered; SVC-012 consumes it, performs assessment, and publishes OverdraftAssessmentCompleted. No synchronous cross-capability call.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Async event via Event Bus — OverdraftReviewTriggered (EVT-114)
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: CAP-001 -> CAP-004 boundary. Triggers credit assessment.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Async event via Event Bus — OverdraftAssessmentCompleted (EVT-115)
cross_service_interaction_summary.note: CAP-004 -> CAP-001 boundary. Returns assessment results.

cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: Synchronous REST — Credit bureau API call

cross_service_interaction_summary.note: Platform service call. Not a cross-capability interaction.
